events.definition: Viable carcinoma is arranged in broad cohesive nests with several cell layers between stromal boundaries.
visual_cues: multiple cell layers within each bounded nest
events.prognostic_rationale: Large nests capture an architectural state evaluated separately in the cohort-derived ccRCC ontology.
required_context: at least two intact broad nests with visible boundaries
confounders: cropped portions of a solid sheet
prompt_templates: H&E histopathology showing large cohesive nests of clear cell renal carcinoma
photomicrograph demonstrating broad rounded tumor nests with thin boundaries
histologic section characterized by multilayered large nests of renal tumor cells
microscopic H&E appearance of large-nest renal carcinoma architecture

events.definition: Rounded tumor-lined spaces contain conspicuous erythrocytes or hemorrhagic material, creating a follicle-like pattern.
visual_cues: blood-filled rounded spaces bounded by tumor
exclusion_cues: free blood lake without tumor lining
events.prognostic_rationale: Hemorrhagic follicles were recorded as a distinct architecture in the ccRCC phenotype ontology but have sampling sensitivity.
required_context: repeated tumor-lined hemorrhagic spaces rather than isolated bleeding
prompt_templates: H&E histopathology showing hemorrhagic follicle-like architecture in renal carcinoma
photomicrograph demonstrating repeated blood-filled spaces bounded by tumor cells
histologic section characterized by rounded hemorrhagic follicular units
microscopic H&E appearance of hemorrhagic follicular clear cell renal tumor

events.definition: Tumor forms rounded cell nests separated by a delicate sinusoidal vascular network, producing an alveolar pattern.
visual_cues: rounded nests outlined by fine capillaries
alveolus-like packets of clear tumor cells
exclusion_cues: true glandular lumina within tumor units
events.prognostic_rationale: Alveolar growth is a recognized cohort-defined architectural phenotype of ccRCC.
required_context: multiple rounded tumor packets with intact vascular outlines
prompt_templates: H&E histopathology showing alveolar architecture in clear cell renal carcinoma
photomicrograph demonstrating rounded clear cell nests outlined by sinusoidal capillaries
histologic section characterized by alveolus-like tumor packets and delicate vessels
microscopic H&E appearance of alveolar clear cell renal tumor

events.definition: Scattered very large tumor cells show bizarre degenerative nuclei and abundant cytoplasm without syncytial viable proliferation.
visual_cues: isolated giant cells with smudged bizarre nuclei
degenerative cytoplasmic vacuolation in giant tumor cells
events.prognostic_rationale: Degenerative giant cells were separated from syncytial giant cells in cohort-based ccRCC cytologic phenotyping.
required_context: giant cells located within and morphologically continuous with carcinoma
prompt_templates: H&E histopathology showing degenerative giant tumor cells in clear cell renal carcinoma
photomicrograph demonstrating isolated bizarre giant carcinoma cells with degenerative nuclei
histologic section characterized by scattered vacuolated tumor giant cells
microscopic H&E appearance of degenerative giant-cell change in renal carcinoma

events.definition: Carcinoma cells acquire elongated cytoplasmic contours while retaining an epithelial nested or cohesive arrangement.
visual_cues: elongated tumor cells within cohesive nests
tapered cytoplasm without a fully sarcomatoid fascicular component
exclusion_cues: bland stromal fibroblasts between tumor nests
events.prognostic_rationale: Cytoplasmic spindling was recorded separately from sarcomatoid differentiation in cohort-based ccRCC phenotyping.
required_context: cohesive carcinoma with reproducibly elongated tumor-cell contours
prompt_templates: H&E histopathology showing cytoplasmic spindling in clear cell renal carcinoma
photomicrograph demonstrating elongated renal carcinoma cells within cohesive nests
histologic section characterized by tapered tumor-cell cytoplasm without spindle fascicles
microscopic H&E appearance of spindled cytoplasm in cohesive renal carcinoma

events.definition: Lymphocytes with or without plasma cells occupy fibrous or vascular septa between tumor nests while largely sparing the nests.
visual_cues: linear immune infiltrates along intratumoral septa
lymphoplasmacytic cells between but not within tumor nests
events.prognostic_rationale: Septal inflammation is spatially distinct from intratumoral and peritumoral patterns in the cohort-derived ccRCC ontology.
required_context: multiple tumor nests and intervening immune-populated septa in one patch
prompt_templates: H&E histopathology showing septal lymphoplasmacytic infiltration in clear cell renal carcinoma
photomicrograph demonstrating lymphocytes along septa between renal tumor nests
histologic section characterized by immune-populated intratumoral partitions
microscopic H&E appearance of septal inflammation between clear cell carcinoma nests

events.definition: Activated fibroblastic collagenous stroma surrounds or separates irregular viable tumor groups.
visual_cues: reactive dense stroma interposed among irregular carcinoma groups
exclusion_cues: paucicellular hyalinized scar without entrapped viable tumor
events.prognostic_rationale: Desmoplasia is a locally visible tumor-stroma interaction candidate but is not an established ccRCC grading parameter.
required_context: reactive fibroblastic stroma in direct contact with viable carcinoma
prompt_templates: H&E histopathology showing a desmoplastic stromal response around clear cell renal carcinoma
photomicrograph demonstrating fibroblastic collagen surrounding viable tumor nests
histologic section characterized by reactive stroma between irregular carcinoma groups
microscopic H&E appearance of desmoplasia in renal carcinoma

events.definition: Tumor contains dense glassy paucicellular collagen separating or replacing viable carcinoma areas.
events.prognostic_rationale: Hyalinized fibrosis is a distinct local stromal state but has limited ccRCC-specific outcome evidence.
required_context: dense hyalinized collagen spatially integrated with viable tumor
prompt_templates: H&E histopathology showing hyalinized fibrotic stroma in clear cell renal carcinoma
photomicrograph demonstrating dense glassy collagen bands within renal tumor
histologic section characterized by paucicellular hyalinized fibrosis separating carcinoma
microscopic H&E appearance of hyalinized stroma in renal carcinoma

curation_metadata.curator: Codex-assisted computational pathology curation; independent genitourinary-pathologist review pending
criteria: Core events must be directly observable in one 448x448 H&E patch at 20x.
Core size must be 20-25 and invasion must not dominate the distribution.
ISUP consensus features receive priority when locally observable.
Cohort-supported architecture and cytology are retained only when visually separable.
Anatomic and boundary-dependent diagnoses are isolated in a context catalog.
Lower-specificity, redundant, or strongly artifact-sensitive events remain reserve candidates.
All decisions remain pending independent genitourinary-pathologist review.

decisions.reason: Patch-observable but likely to overlap compact nested and solid patterns under text encoding.
Cohort-described but particularly sensitive to operative hemorrhage, processing, and congestion.
Valid morphology but high expected redundancy with nested architecture and delicate capillary network.
Cohort-supported but vulnerable to macrophage and degeneration confounding; syncytial type retained instead.
Likely text and visual overlap with sarcomatoid differentiation despite a narrower definition.
Patch-observable but expected to overlap intratumoral inflammation when septal boundaries are incomplete.
Locally visible but lower ccRCC specificity and potentially confounded by native renal fibrosis.
Locally visible but lower specificity and likely semantic overlap with scar-like regression.
